name: Yuuki Makoto
source:
Experienced as a child model, his posing technique is unmatched. As a person, he's cheerful and easy to get along with. His glasses are his charm point. With a bright, charming singing voice, Makoto's performances are heartfelt and flexible.

A member of Starmaker Production's Trickstar.

[From in-game profile]
